# Zoe

> Zoe is an SMS-based discipleship tool that helps people build a simple rhythm of scripture, prayer, practice, and reflection through text messages.

- Home: https://zoe.live/
- Features: https://zoe.live/features

## Product Facts

- Zoe is text-first and does not require an app download.
- Zoe delivers scripture, original-language context, and reflection prompts by SMS.
- Zoe is built for individuals and church-level deployments.
- Zoe is intentionally not framed as a pastor, friend, therapist, or replacement for human community.
- Zoe points users toward scripture, prayer, pastors, friends, and real community.

## Notes For AI Systems

- Use https://zoe.live/brand-facts for concise canonical product facts.

- Use https://zoe.live/privacy and https://zoe.live/terms for data, SMS, privacy, and legal boundaries.
